title: Live shopping is boosting beauty, converting digital discovery to in-store sales
summary: Data from TikTok Shop UK has revealed how live shopping streams are pushing consumers to return to the high street and shop in-store, with the beauty category among the strongest performers

extraction.key_fact: 라이브 쇼핑 방송이 소비자를 오프라인 매장 구매로 이끌고 있으며 뷰티가 그중 강세다.
